author: Another_Absurdist
body:
I got into Summoners when they first came out, and have no plans to swap - they're good at lower levels, especially for world and kingdom raids, and are ready to rock immediately at Tier 10. Chimera summons are murder machines.  If you like casters and don't mind sitting and watching your summon AI kill things for you, I think the Summoner line is great!

Weak points - squishy caster, if summons (I like calling them minions) don't take the hits you can die pretty quick (RNG dependent).  Summons AI can be frustrating (defending instead of finishing off an opponent, etc).  Base stats are low, except for high Foresight.  Can be taken out while summoning your minions (PVP weak point).  Best gear drops were during the Rift event, don't know when it'll be back.  Can be a bit boring after your minions are summoned, just defending and watching them fight, summoning more as needed.  Enemies with resistances can wreck the wrong minion loadout (Knight Sirus, and more commonly Mighty Mimics, were dungeon enders for me at first).  Low spell slot count - one reason I went with Magus/Maji specialization).  Running out of mana could be trouble, if you need to replace minions in a raid constantly (another reason I went Maji).

Strong points: Don't need much gear besides Summon boosters and possibly survivability insurance, your minions do the damage (unless you're doing Blood Pact spells - you need high Mag for that).  High survivability when summons block for you - if you can survive a hit, you usually get a few turns to recover (RNG dependent, and assuming you have minions summoned to take hits).  You still do damage while healing or buffing, as long as you have summons up - great turn efficiency.  Multiple attacks to take on evasive enemies.  Can get good status effect combos from minions (if you have Very Scary Skeletons, their Wallop gives T. Def+Res Down 2 - wrecks high def/res bosses like Rhada and Cerus.  (Also good for PVP defense penetration.)  Farming - I can equip exp/orn focused farming gear and still kill quickly and effectively (that is, my minions kill quickly and effectively for me), without getting killed first (thanks minion tanks!).

;tldr  I really like Summoners - good survivability in general, can be effective without optimal gear, and imo get better in relative utility increasing in tiers.  I have both Heretic and Grand Summoner, and I'm sticking with the Summoner.

P.S. Rhada Pact plus Lugus Gauntlet boosts = murder machine minions (at least for a few turns).

I am kinda in the same situation, I am Great Attuner but have unlocked up to t8 all the mage classes too because I liked to swap between summoning and mage class (mage clears arena faster I think).

I have 10m orns RN and was pondering between unlocking Summoner as soon as I get 1m more orn, buy Omni and go with it for a while till I make the orns back or hold on to the orns all together because of the event pets that are coming this month (I have none event pets since I started only 5 o 6 weeks ago).

​

In the end I decided to hold onto my orn for now and if I get to 14/15m orns get Summoner and keep the remaining orns to grab some important pets from the event. I can clear t9 content with Grand Attuner sooo not feeling like in a rush at the moment.
